name: _meta
script: return "灯箱真实输入链路（sendInputEvent 走完整输入管线）：真实点击照片开灯箱 → 灯箱根 no-drag 断言（拖拽区不再吞点击）→ 真实点击 X 关闭 → 真实点击 ... 出菜单（置于最上层）→ 单击缩放/双击防抖/滚轮/背景关闭。前置：gen-demo 演示数据。"

name: 02-open-kyoto
script: for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(el => el.textContent.includes('京都')); if (h) { h.click(); return 'ok'; } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); } throw new Error('找不到京都（超时）')

name: 03-wall-loaded
script: if (!document.querySelector('[data-testid=photo-wall] img')) throw new Error('照片墙未加载'); 'wall-ok'

name: 04-real-click-photo-opens-lightbox
script: if (!document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-root] .viewer-polaroid img')) throw new Error('真实点击照片未打开灯箱'); 'lightbox-open-ok'

name: 05-lightbox-no-drag-assert
script: const root = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-root]'); if (!root) throw new Error('灯箱缺失'); const region = getComputedStyle(root).webkitAppRegion; if (region !== 'no-drag') throw new Error('灯箱根未豁免窗口拖拽区（顶栏按钮会被吞点击）: ' + region); 'no-drag-ok'

name: 06-real-click-x-closes
script: for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { if (!document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-root]')) return 'x-close-ok'; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } throw new Error('真实点击 X 未关闭灯箱（drag-region 或命中问题仍在）')

name: 08-real-click-more-menu
script: const panel = document.querySelector('.ctx-menu-panel'); if (!panel) throw new Error('真实点击 ... 未出现菜单'); const item = panel.querySelector('[role=menuitem]'); if (!item) throw new Error('菜单无条目'); const r = item.getBoundingClientRect(); const hit = document.elementFromPoint(r.left + r.width / 2, r.top + r.height / 2); if (!hit || !hit.closest('.ctx-menu-panel')) throw new Error('菜单被其他层盖住（elementFromPoint 命中: ' + (hit && hit.className) + '）'); 'more-menu-ok'

name: 09-real-click-menu-item
script: if (document.querySelector('.ctx-menu-panel')) throw new Error('点击菜单项后菜单未关闭'); 'menu-item-click-ok'

name: 09b-close-caption-editor
script: const cancel = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '取消'); if (cancel) { cancel.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); } if ([...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.textContent.trim() === '保存' && b.closest('.fixed'))) throw new Error('图注编辑器未关闭'); 'editor-closed'

name: 10-menu-shot
script: document.querySelector('[title=更多操作]').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); if (!document.querySelector('.ctx-menu-panel')) throw new Error('菜单未再次出现'); 'menu-open'

name: 11-outside-click-closes-menu
script: document.body.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 350)); if (document.querySelector('.ctx-menu-panel')) throw new Error('点击菜单外未关闭菜单'); if (!document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-root] .viewer-polaroid img')) throw new Error('菜单外点击误关了灯箱'); 'outside-menu-ok'

name: 12-zoom-initial-cursor
script: const img = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-root] .viewer-polaroid img'); if (!img) throw new Error('灯箱图片缺失'); if (getComputedStyle(img).cursor !== 'zoom-in') throw new Error('初始光标应为 zoom-in: ' + getComputedStyle(img).cursor); const stage = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-stage]'); if (getComputedStyle(stage).cursor === 'zoom-in') throw new Error('图片外不应显示放大镜'); 'cursor-init-ok'

name: 13-single-click-zoom
script: const img = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-root] .viewer-polaroid img'); img.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: img.getBoundingClientRect().left + 20, clientY: img.getBoundingClientRect().top + 20 })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const box = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-stage-box]'); const style = box.getAttribute('style') ?? ''; if (!/scale\(2\.5\)/.test(style)) throw new Error('单击未放大: ' + style); if (getComputedStyle(img).cursor !== 'zoom-out') throw new Error('放大后光标应为 zoom-out: ' + getComputedStyle(img).cursor); 'click-zoom-ok'

name: 14-single-click-back-fit
script: const img = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-root] .viewer-polaroid img'); img.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: img.getBoundingClientRect().left + 20, clientY: img.getBoundingClientRect().top + 20 })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const style = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-stage-box]').getAttribute('style') ?? ''; if (/scale\((?!1\)).*\)/.test(style)) throw new Error('单击未复位: ' + style); if (getComputedStyle(img).cursor !== 'zoom-in') throw new Error('复位后光标应为 zoom-in'); 'click-fit-ok'

name: 15-double-click-single-toggle
script: const img = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-root] .viewer-polaroid img'); const r = img.getBoundingClientRect(); const opt = { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: r.left + 20, clientY: r.top + 20 }; img.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', opt)); img.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', opt)); img.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('dblclick', opt)); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); const style = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-stage-box]').getAttribute('style') ?? ''; if (!/scale\(2\.5\)/.test(style)) throw new Error('双击应恰好切换一次到放大: ' + style); 'dblclick-ok'

name: 16-wheel-zoom-and-back
script: window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '0' })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 350)); const stage = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-stage]'); const r = stage.getBoundingClientRect(); stage.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, deltaY: -120, clientX: r.left + r.width / 2, clientY: r.top + r.height / 2 })); await new Promise(r2 => setTimeout(r2, 300)); let style = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-stage-box]').getAttribute('style') ?? ''; if (!/scale\(1\.[1-9]/.test(style)) throw new Error('滚轮未放大: ' + style); const img = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-root] .viewer-polaroid img'); if (getComputedStyle(img).cursor !== 'zoom-out') throw new Error('滚轮放大后光标应为 zoom-out'); for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { stage.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, deltaY: 120, clientX: r.left + r.width / 2, clientY: r.top + r.height / 2 })); await new Promise(r2 => setTimeout(r2, 60)); } await new Promise(r2 => setTimeout(r2, 300)); style = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-stage-box]').getAttribute('style') ?? ''; if (/scale\((?!1\)).*\)/.test(style)) throw new Error('滚轮未缩回 fit: ' + style); if (getComputedStyle(img).cursor !== 'zoom-in') throw new Error('滚轮缩回 fit 后光标应恢复 zoom-in'); 'wheel-ok'

name: 17-backdrop-click-closes
script: const stage = document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-stage]'); stage.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: stage.getBoundingClientRect().left + 30, clientY: stage.getBoundingClientRect().top + 30 })); for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { if (!document.querySelector('[data-testid=lightbox-root]')) return 'backdrop-close-ok'; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } throw new Error('点击图片外未关闭灯箱')
